name: Leopard
overview: The Bible depicts the leopard as a swift, fierce, and carnivorous animal that lies in wait for its prey, symbolizing both natural ferocity and divine judgment, as seen in Jeremiah 5:6 and Hosea 13:7. Its spotted skin is used figuratively to illustrate the unchangeable nature of habitual sin in Jeremiah 13:23. Daniel 7:6 portrays the leopard as a powerful, multi-headed beast representing the Macedonian empire, while Isaiah 11:6 envisions a future peace where even the leopard is tamed, symbolizing the triumph of the gospel over wickedness.
